The '''lightstorm chamber''' was an automated defense device. When it was triggered, lasers cut through whatever was the trigger. One chamber was part of the [[Shogar Tok's fortress|fortress]] of [[Shogar Tok]],<ref name="Jedi:Shaak">''[[Jedi: Shaak Ti]]''</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] leader of the planet<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|269|Lyshaa}}</ref> [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].<ref name="Jedi:Shaak" />
